source: 760 Second Day
target: 760 Dies Secunda

source: 760 Second Day
target: 760 Dies Secunda

source: In the Southern Continent, Raklev region, the day revealed Lake Dalsh in all its clarity, the serene waters reflecting the azure sky and distant snow-capped mountains in a scene almost dreamlike in its beauty.
target: In Continente Australi, in regione Raklev, dies patefecit Lacum Dalsh omni sua claritate, cum aquis serenis caelum azureum atque montibus nive coronatis remotis speciem repraesentantibus in scaena paene quasi somnifera ob eius decorem.

source: Lumian, devoid of any mood to appreciate the scenery, was strolling around a pit at the forest’s edge with Ludwig, who was smartly dressed in a tweed blazer, and Lugano, who wore a light cotton coat.
target: Lumian, animō carēns ad scaenam admirandam, circa fovem ad margō silvā ambulabat, cum Ludovico, quī veste tweedi eleganter indūtus erat, et Lugano, quī in tunica levissima ex cottonīs indūtus apparēbat.

source: The pit contained highly decayed bodies, half-melted into the surrounding soil as if merging with it, decomposing in a unique way that returned nutrients to the earth.
target: Fossa continēbat corpora valde corrupta, semiliquata in terram circumiectam quasi eam connēscēns, in modo unico putrescēns, quī nutrimenta ad terram reddebāt.

source: Seeing this, Lumian understood why Oxyto, a Shaman King, didn’t destroy the bodies after his rituals, leaving behind evidence and traces: burying the bodies and allowing them to return to the land was likely part of the ritual!
target: Hoc vidēns, Lumian intellexit cur Oxyto, Rex Shamanōrum, corpora post rituōs suōs nōn deleverit et vestigia relinquī: sepelīre corpora et sinere ea ad terram redīre verisimiliter partem rituōs fuisset!

source: Last night, after reviewing the documents provided by the Knight of Swords, Lumian had a clearer idea of how to find Oxyto, a fervent disciple of the Primordial Moon.
target: Heri nocte, postquam documenta a Equeste Gladii provisa examināvit, Lumian clārius intellexit quōmodo Oxyto, fervidus discipulus Lunae Primordialis, reperīretur.

source: Clearly, conventional methods like Magic Mirror Divination wouldn’t work; otherwise, the Knight of Swords’ companion, a member of the temperance faction with sharp spiritual intuition, would have already located Oxyto.
target: Plane, methodi usitatae ut Divinātiō per Speculum Magicum nōn funcionarent; aliter, comes Eques Gladii, membrum factionis temperantis cum perspicuā intūitiōne spiritualī, iam Oxyto reperīretur.

source: Lumian had three plans:
target: Lumian trēs consilia habēbat:

source: First, since Oxyto was a member of the Rose School of Thought and often mingled with the indulgence faction, he started by sending Franca and Jenna, both Demonesses, to casually stroll through Raklev City in full regalia, hoping to encounter Oxyto.
target: Prīmō, quoniam Oxyto membrum Scholae Rōsā Ideārum erat et saepe cum factione indulgentiā miscēbātur, incepit mittendō Francam et Jennam, ambae daemonissae, ut per urbem Raklev in plena pompa casualiter ambularent, sperāns Oxyto occurrēmus.

source: This Shaman King, who never resisted his desires, might approach them, all under the watchful protection of the temperance faction.
target: Hic Rex Shamanōrum, quī numquam desideriis suīs resistit, fortasse ad eōs accedere posset, omnia sub vigilantia factionis temperantis.

source: Additionally, Anthony would use Psychological Invisibility or disguise himself as a commoner to follow them and observe the reactions of those around the Demonesses to discern any malice before Oxyto made a move.
target: Praeterea, Antonius aut Invisibilitātem Psychologicam adhiberet aut se ut vulgaris transfigurāret, eos secūtus et reactionēs circa daemonissās observāret, ut ullam malitiam ante quam Oxyto moverētur discerneret.

source: Whether or not Oxyto had received the Great Mother’s boons and transformed into a woman was a detail that didn’t affect the Demonesses’ ability to seduce him.
target: Utrum Oxyto beneficiora Magnae Mātris accepisset et in feminam se transformavisset, ērant res quae virtutem daemonissārum ad eum sedūcendum nōn afficiebat.

source: Lumian deduced from Madame Pualis’s and Franca’s experiences that Oxyto would still be attracted to women, and might as well have an interest in men.
target: Lumian ex experientiīs Dominae Pualis et Francae concludit Oxyto ad mūlēs adhūc attrahī, atque fortasse etiam ad vīrōs interit.

source: Second, using his own lineage from Omebella, and the unique ability of the Great Mother’s blessed to sense others within a certain distance, he planned to roam the Raklev area in hopes of drawing out Oxyto.
target: Secundō, utens sēva stirpē ex Omebella ac singularī facultāte benedictōrum Magnae Mātris cēteros intra certam distantiam sentī, consilium cepit per regionem Raklev vagārī, sperāns Oxyto evocārī.

source: Similarly, Lugano, who also bore an anomaly possibly linked to the Great Mother, would serve as excellent bait.
target: Similiter, Lugano, quī etiam anomaliam, fortasse cum Magnā Mātre connexam, ferēbat, optima esca fungī nāturus erat.

source: Third, he considered revisiting the sites Oxyto had been before to see what could be eaten.
target: Tertium, meditātus est loca quō Oxyto anteā frequentāverat iterum visitāre, ut vidēret quid edendum esset.

source: Pinching his nose, Lumian carefully inspected the traces around and inside the pit along with the numerous bodies for a while, then turned his head to ask Ludwig, “Is it dirty?”
target: Nasum compremēns, Lumian diligenter vestigia circa et intrā fovem, simul cum numerōs corporum, per aliquod tempus inspexit, deinde caput vertēns Ludovico rogāvit: “Squalida estne?”

source: “Very dirty,” Ludwig nodded emphatically.
target: “Valde squalida,” Ludovicus emphaticē inclināvit caput.

source: “Dirty from the Great Mother?” Lumian pressed further.
target: “Squalida ob Magnam Mātrem?” Lumian ulterius interrogāvit.

source: Ludwig hummed affirmatively, his expression filled with conflict.
target: Ludovicus sonum assentientem edidit, vultū conflictu plēnō.

source: Unsurprisingly, he heard his godfather ask, “Is it edible?”
target: Non mirum, audivit patrinum suum rogāre: “Edibilis estne?”

source: At this question, Lugano couldn’t help but gag, while the usually stoic Knight of Swords, Maric, slightly raised his eyebrows.
target: Ad hanc quaestiōnem, Lugano, quasi vomitus imminēns, se non potuit absterner, dum Miles Gladii, Maric, solitus stoicus, leviter superciliā attollēbat.

source: Ludwig replied reluctantly, “Yes.”
target: Ludovicus dubitāns respondit: “Ita.”

source: “Can you sense the child born from these corpses after eating?” Lumian further inquired.
target: “Potesne sentī puerum, quī ex his corporibus post escam natus est?” Lumian ulterius rogāvit.

source: Based on his experience, these bodies had likely been impregnated during the ritual, carrying rapidly growing clawed bird-like creatures in their wombs, which then tore through their parents’ abdomens, absorbing the remnants and emerging on their own.
target: Ex suā experientiā, haec corpora verisimiliter in ritu impregnata erant, portātā in utero creatūrās, similes avibus ungulātīs celeriter crescentēs, quæ deinde per abdomina parentum lacerābant, reliquiās devorantes et sē ipsās emergentēs.

source: From a mysticism standpoint, whether voluntarily or forcibly, the clawed bird-like creatures and the corpses shared a deep blood connection, making it easy to trace one from the other, or even cast curses across distances.
target: Ex prospectū mysticō—sive voluntāriē sive vi—creatūrae avium ungulātārum et corpora profunde sanguinis vinculō conexa erant, quod facile uno ex alterō inquirere aut etiam maledicta trans distantias iacere sinēbat.

source: However, according to the Knight of Swords’ documents, divinations utilizing this blood connection had been fruitless, as if the creatures that had emerged from these corpses had vanished from this world.
target: Attamen, secundum documenta Eques Gladii, divinātiōnēs hanc sanguinis coniunctionem utentēs infructuosae fuerunt, quasi creatūrae quæ ex his corporibus emergērunt ex hoc mōndō evanuerint.

source: This could be due to a high-ranking individual casting a counter-divination or a change in the creatures’ state.
target: Hoc fierī potuit ob aliquem summī gradūs individuō, quī divinātiōnem contrā intulisset, aut ob mutātiōnem statūs creatūrārum.

source: Lumian’s only hope was that Ludwig might glean different information by consuming the flesh.
target: Unica spes Luminiana erat ut Ludovicus, carnem comedendō, diversa indicia haurīret.

source: Ludwig, with a sullen face, said, “You can extract a bit of the bloodline from the corpses through a certain cooking method.
target: Ludovicus, vultū maestō, dīxit: “Ex his corporibus, per quandam coctionis rationem, parvam sanguinis stirpem extrahere potes.

source: While this won’t allow me to sense the child’s position and condition from a great distance, I should be able to detect its presence within a thirty-meter radius.”
target: Quamquam hoc nōn sinet mihi locum et condicionem puerī ex longinqua sentīre, credo tamen intra triginta metrorum radius eius praesentiam detegere posse.”

source: “Okay,” Lumian felt the results were better than expected.
target: “Bene,” Lumian sensit eventūs melius quam sperāverat.

source: Then, he watched as Ludwig squatted down and used a child’s silver knife and fork to separate a piece of half-melted, half-rotten flesh from one of the corpses.
target: Deinde vidit Ludovicum genu flectēns, cultellum et furculam argenteam puerilem utentem, ut partem carnis semiliquātā et semirotā e quōlo corporum segregāret.

source: The flowing yellow pus and the grotesque state of the flesh made Lugano turn away, looking out towards Lake Dalsh and Raklev City on the other side of the water.
target: Fluens pus flavus et status carnis deformis fēcērunt Lugano se avertīre, perspiciēns versus Lacum Dalsh atque urbem Raklev in altera aquae parte.

source: Ludwig then had Lumian retrieve a cast-iron skillet, a stand, wheat flour, liqueur, various spices, and a chunk of solidified lard from the Traveler’s Bag.
target: Ludovicus deinde iussit Luminian adferrere sartāgionem ex ferro fundītō, statīvum, farinā triticī, liquorem, varīās specias aromāticās et partem lardi solidificātī ex sacculo Viātōris.

source: Lumian took on the role of the Chef’s assistant, mainly responsible for starting the fire.
target: Lumian munus adiūtoris coquōrum suscepit, prācīpe responsābilis ad ignem accendendō.

source: Ludwig first melted the lard, then added a bit of liqueur and some spices, frying them until the mixture was richly aromatic.
target: Ludovicus primō lardum liquefēcit, deinde paulum liquorem atque aliquās species addidit, fricēns, donec mixtūra opulente aromātica fīeret.

source: Next, he wrapped the rotten flesh in wheat flour and tossed it into the skillet, frying it in the deeply colored, fragrant lard.
target: Deinde carnem putridam in farinā triticī involvit et in sartāginem iacuit, fricēns eam in lardo opime colorātō atque odorātō.

source: The odors of fragrance and foul mingled together, gradually spreading.
target: Odōra suāvē et foeda simul mixtā erant, paulatim diffundentēs.

source: Finally, Ludwig finished cooking and forked up the fried, golden-brown flour-coated meatball, stuffing it into his mouth.
target: Denique Ludovicus coquendi finem attigit et globum carnis fritum, farina aureo-brunne inductum, cum furculā cepit et in os suum intulit.

source: He chewed, tears seemingly welling up in his eyes, looking pitiful as if wronged.
target: Mandūcāvit, lacrimae in oculīs quasi orīrī videbantur, miserābilis aspiciens quasi iniuriā affectus.

source: “You didn’t complain when you ate Loki raw,” Lumian joked.
target: “Non quereris cum Loki crudelem edistī,” iocātus est Lumian.

source: Ludwig muttered as he spoke, “Rotten doesn’t taste good, and there’s no spirituality in it.”
target: Ludovicus, murmurāns, dīxit: “Putridum nōn sapit bene, nec in eo aliqua spiritualitās inveniuntur.”

source: After swallowing the fried meatball that looked rather appealing, Ludwig continued thoughtfully as he savored it, “The deceased’s birthday is on the second day of every year.”
target: Postquam globum carnis fritum, satis delectābilem, deglūtīvit, Ludovicus meditabundō perrexit dīcēns: “Dies nātālis defunctī in secunda die uniuscuiusque annī est.”

source: “Is there something special about that?” Lumian asked.
target: “Estne aliquid speciale in hoc?” rogāvit Lumian.

source: Stuffing candy into his mouth, Ludwig responded offhandedly, “In myths, on the first day, the Oldest One created the world; on the second, the Great Mother was born.”
target: Dulcia in os suum intulēns, Ludovicus leviter respondit: “In fabulis, in prima die, Vetustissimus mundum creāvit; in secunda, Magna Mātres nata est.”

source: “I’ve never heard of such a myth…” Lugano murmured to himself, puzzled, with his back to Ludwig.
target: “Numquam talem fabulam audīvī…” Lugano sibi murmūrābat, perplexus, dorsi ad Ludovicum.

source: Lumian, deep in thought, shifted his gaze to another body.
target: Lumian, altē cogitāns, oculōs suōs in alterum corpus vertit.

source: “Their birthdays couldn’t all be on the second day of each year, could they?
target: “Nativitātēs eōrum omnēs nōn possunt in secunda die uniuscuiusque annī esse, nonne?”

source: “I remember that the new year for many tribes on the Southern Continent isn’t the same as on the Northern Continent; it’s not necessarily January 1st.
target: “Meminī novum annum multārum tribuum in Continente Australi nōn eōdem esse ac in Continente Septentrionālī; nōn necessario ut sit Kalenda Ianuaria prima.

source: So, which day is the second day, and which calendar are we using?”
target: Ergō, quae dēs sit dies secunda, et quō calendāriō utimur?”

source: Ludwig, with candy in his mouth, said, “Any would do, as long as it’s the second day of the new year according to the calendar one believes in.”
target: Ludovicus, dulcia in ore gerēns, dīxit: “Quicumque sufficit, dummodo sit dies secunda novi annī secundum calendārium cui credātur.”

source: Purely symbolic, then… Lumian turned towards the Knight of Swords.
target: Sola symbolice, igitur… Lumian versus Eques Gladii se vertit.

source: “Have you confirmed the identities and birthdays of these bodies?”
target: “Confirmāvistine identitātēs et diēs nātalēs harum corporum?”

source: Raklev in the Star Highlands was a relatively prosperous area with a significant population, similar to the City of White Rapus, where Lumian had been before.
target: Raklev in Montibus Stellātīs fuit regio relative prospēra cum magna populātiōne, similis Urbi Albae Rapus, quam Lumian ante visitāverat.

source: It was one of the ancient Highlands Kingdom’s support points ruling over the entire Star Highlands.
target: Erat una ex antiquīs stationibus sustentātiōnis Regni Montānī, quī totōs Montēs Stellātōs dominābat.

source: This area was known for its rich mines, but interestingly, all mining sites were far from Lake Dalsh, preserving the sanctity of this highland lake in the hearts of its people.
target: Haec regio nota erat ob opulentās fodināriās; sed mirum, omnes loci fodināriī longe ab Lacum Dalsh erant, sacralitātem huius lacus altomontānī in cordibus populī servātōs.

source: In the past, the Star Highlands were primarily a battleground between the Intis Republic and the Feysac Empire.
target: Olim, Montes Stellātī fere erant ager pugnandī inter Rempublicam Intis et Imperium Feysac.

source: After the war a few years ago, the Feysac Empire’s influence waned, and the Loen Kingdom began to extend its reach.
target: Post bellum aliquot annōs praeterītōs, potentia Imperiī Feysac decrescit, et Regnum Loen diffusionem suam augere coepit.

source: Even the Evernight Goddess Church of Loen Kingdom seemed to be spreading its teachings in this area—a fact Lumian had heard about while in Rapus.
target: Etiam Ecclesia Deae Perpetuae Noctis Regni Loen videbātur sua praecepta in hac regione dissemināre—a rem, quam Lumian in Rapus audīverat.

source: And throughout the Star Highlands, the city atop the mines, Raklev, had the largest Loenese population.
target: Et per Montes Stellātōs, urbs super fodināriās—Raklev—maximam populātiōnem Loenensium habēbat.

source: Knight of Swords Maric nodded slowly and said, “We’ve confirmed 90% of the bodies; their birthdays, according to the Northern Continent’s calendar, are mostly on January 2nd.
target: Miles Gladii Maric lente annuivit et dīxit: “Nonaginta percentum corporum confirmāvimus; diēs nātālēs eōrum, secundum calendārium Continenti Septentrionālī, plerumque in secunda die Ianuariī cadunt.

source: For the rest, using local calendars, their birthdays also fall on the second day of the new year.
target: Ad cetera, ex calendāriīs regionalibus utentibus, diēs nātālēs eōrum quoque in secunda die novi annī cadunt.

source: “For those whose identities remain uncertain, they seem to be foreigners, who may have come here either voluntarily or involuntarily.
target: “Illōrum, quarum identitātēs incertae manent, videntur esse peregrinī, qui huc vel voluntāriē vel invitō advenerunt.

source: Give us a bit more time, and we’ll surely determine who they are.”
target: Da nōbīs paulum temporis, et certe cognoscēmus quī sint.

source: With a sufficiently large sample, the findings mostly align with Ludwig’s explanation that the ritual required a strong symbol of the Great Mother…
target: Cum exemplum satis ample, inventa plerumque congruunt cum Ludovicī explicatione quō ritu signum validum Magnae Mātris necessarium erat…

source: Lumian didn’t stop the more temperance faction members from wasting energy verifying the remaining deceased’s identities—what if there was something else peculiar?
target: Lumian nōn impedīvit membrīs factionis temperantis ne energiam terēre in reliquārum defunctorum identitātibus verificandīs—quid, sī aliquid aliud peculīārem esset?

source: Looking across the lake at Raklev City, Lumian said, “Let’s head back to the city now and walk around.”
target: Trans Lacum ad Urbem Raklev aspiciēns, Lumian dīxit: “Nunc ad urbem redeāmus et circūm ambulemus.”

source: Let’s see which of the three are more effective—Omebella’s bloodline, the anomaly of the Earth pathway, or the blood connection with the bird-clawed babies!
target: Videāmus quae trium efficacius sit—stirps Omebellae, anomalia itineris terrānae, aut nexus sanguineus cum infāntibus avium ungulātīs!

source: Walking towards the city, made of numerous gray and white stone houses, along the shimmering lake as blue as the sky, Lumian suddenly had a thought.
target: Ambulāns ad urbem, ex plurimīs cinereīs et albīs lapideīs domīs confectā, iuxta lacum scintillantem tam caerūleum quam caelum, Lumian subito rem cogitāvit.

source: He asked the quiet Knight of Swords walking beside him, “In the Rose School of Thought, was Oxyto in charge of the Raklev area?”
target: Rogāvit quietum Equestem Gladii, quī iuxta eum ambulābat: “In Schola Rōsā Ideārum, num Oxyto curam regionis Raklev gerebat?”

source: “Not previously, and now it’s uncertain,” replied the Knight of Swords succinctly.
target: “Non anteā; nunc autem incertum est,” respondit Eques Gladii succinctē.

source: Lumian nodded, musing to himself, “If he isn’t in charge of Raklev and merely initiated a ritual here on a whim, he should have left after it ended.
target: Lumian annuivit, meditandō sibi: “Sī nōn de Raklev curam gerat et tantum hinc rituōrum impulsus fuerit capriciōnibus, post finem īllum discessurus esse debuīt.”

source: Why is he still here?
target: Cur adhuc hic manet?

source: “Does he have a deeper purpose in the Raklev area?
target: “Num habet propositum profundius in regione Raklev?

source: Or perhaps, the Rose School of Thought is planning something for this place?”
target: Aut fortasse Schola Rōsā Ideārum aliquid huic loco parat?”

source: The Knight of Swords paused for a few seconds before responding, “We suspect there might be a deeper purpose.”
target: Eques Gladii paulum cessāvit antequam responderet: “Suspicimur quī propositum profundius esse possit.”

source: Pausing momentarily, he added, “Before the Highlands Kingdom was established, many areas of the Star Highlands worshiped Death, and Raklev was one of the places most influenced by this belief.
target: Intermissū paulo, addidit: “Antequam Regnum Montānum institūtum esset, pleraeque partes Montium Stellātōrum Mortem colere solebant, et Raklev erat una ex locīs maxime huic fide affīnata.”

source: Even today, some local customs still carry remnants of this death worship.
target: Etiam hōdie, quaedam consuetūdines localēs reliquiās huius cultūs mortis portābant.

source: As they spoke, the three adults and one child arrived outside Raklev City.
target: Dum loquēbantur, trēs adultī et ūnum puer extra urbem Raklev advenerunt.

source: Raklev, compared to the refined City of White Rapus, the architecture here was much more rugged.
target: Raklev, comparāta ad urbem exquisītam Albām Rapus, architectūra hīc multō asperior erat.

source: Although there were people in dark red robes and bright dresses, most wore more durable canvas work clothes.
target: Quamquam erant hominēs indūtī in tunicīs rubeīs obscūrīs et vestimentīs nitīdīs, plērīque indūmenta robustiora ex tela gestābant.

source: Before even reaching the city gates, Lumian could already sense the hustle and bustle.
target: Antequam ipsam portam urbīs attingeret, Lumian iam sentīre poterat tumultum et festinātiōnem.
